summary: BioMar has reaffirmed its commitment to achieving net-zero emissions as part of its sustainability strategy. The company is intensifying efforts on its decarbonization pathway.
title: BioMar doubles down on its net-zero pathway
title_en: BioMar doubles down on its net-zero pathway

summary: BioMar has announced a commitment to reach net-zero emissions by 2050 or earlier as part of its sustainability strategy. The announcement reflects the aquaculture feed producer's environmental accountability goals aligned with global decarbonization trends.
title: BioMar outlines plan to reach net-zero by ‘no later than 2050’
title_en: BioMar outlines plan to reach net-zero by ‘no later than 2050’
